title: Tickmark - the month-end close that learns
description: An agent that codes AP invoices and reconciles the bank, hands a controller only what needs judgment, and compiles every correction into a deterministic rule so next month costs less.

sections.heading: The close that gets cheaper every month.
sections.text: OFFICE OF THE CFO · MONTH-END CLOSE The close that gets cheaper every month. Tickmark codes the AP ledger and reconciles the bank, hands the controller only what genuinely needs judgment, and compiles every correction they make into a deterministic rule. The judgment gets made once. After that it runs for free. sections.heading: Learning that compiles, not learning that accumulates.
sections.text: WHY IT GETS CHEAPER Learning that compiles, not learning that accumulates. Most agents “learn” by growing a prompt. Every lesson makes the next call longer, slower and more expensive, and none of it can be audited. Tickmark turns a correction into a rule: a predicate and an action, versioned, readable, and executable with no model call at all. The month the agent learns that AWS codes to 6820 split 60/25/15, that invoice stops costing anything to decide - forever. So the cost curve bends the right way. sections.heading: Five steps, and a human owns one of them.
sections.text: THE LOOP Five steps, and a human owns one of them. 01 Rulebook the weights - deterministic rules the agent has already earned 02 Close run the forward pass - rules first, model only on the residue 03 Corrections the loss signal - what the controller changed, captured structurally 04 Gradient step distil corrections into candidate rules, backtested against every closed period 05 The human gate a controller accepts or rejects. sections.text: WHAT IT ACTUALLY DOES Three steps of the close, end to end. Bank reconciliation Ties the statement to the ledger across all four cardinalities - one payment, an ACH batch against six invoices, an invoice settled in two tranches, a lockbox deposit. Names every residual as fx, fee, partial or timing, or refuses the match. AP invoice coding GL account, department, and class per invoice - including the split allocations that are pure tribal knowledge, like cloud spend carved 60/25/15 across Engineering, Data and Product. sections.heading: The parts that make it usable on real books.
sections.text: GUARDRAILS The parts that make it usable on real books. Materiality is a hard gate Nothing above the threshold auto-posts, whatever the confidence. A $12 bank fee and a $2.4M wire do not get the same scrutiny. Debits equal credits Checked arithmetically in the database, never taken from model output. Preparer ≠ approver Enforced by a constraint, not a convention. Tickmarks are append-only You supersede one with a new tickmark. You never edit or delete the record of a verification.
